title: Megalithic architecture on Mars seen by remote viewers
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Megalithic architecture on Mars seen by remote viewers, about millions of years BC at Mars, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: architecture what McMmonle and Swan saw on Mars was a style of architecture that matches the most titanic megalithic structures on Earth

plain: A researcher and philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says that Joe McMoneagle and Ingo Swann, two remote viewers (people who try to see distant places using only the mind), described buildings on Mars. According to Jorjani, the style they saw matches the most enormous ancient stone structures on Earth, the kind built from giant blocks. If true, it would suggest a link between ancient builders on Earth and something once on Mars.
